authorization.provenance: User to Codex after supplying Claude audit 101, no defect in 1c1a3468.

scope: Accept S1-LL11-a at its reviewed binding-installation scope.
exclusions: Manifest module rows match by name; their order does not affect admission.
Completeness is measured against the trusted owner's expected list. An owner omitting an alias from both lists is outside this control's authority.
Failed transactions discard their compiled instances and loader; rolled-back slots can be reused. Retained old module slots are never reused.

Single Worker, synchronous trusted-owner transaction with Lisp execution and collection excluded. The byte provider must not re-enter installation or mutate owner memory. This is catalog integrity, not code signing or cross-Worker atomic publication.

The owner supplies existing D1 symbols, keyword identities, independently expected bindings, catalog and materialized function/pool objects. This is not a package allocator or the LL14 production cross-loader. Top-level metadata words must already equal pool elements zero and one; absent words refuse rather than being repaired.

Only the accepted non-retrying shared B profile is admitted here. The allocator-retry profile, bootstrap image ownership, generic-function method changes and code retirement are separate obligations. Old code is deliberately retained indefinitely; no unload or slot reuse policy is claimed.

Catalog metadata is trusted. Validation checks counts, keyword identities, record shapes and captures, not all nested debug contents. Keyword names are the admitted keyword-symbol subset; capture indices follow environment-slot order.

Entry ranges are complete binary function-body extents, including local declarations, joined to engine-validated export indices. They are not native machine-code addresses or inferred instruction entrypoints.

The compiler and integrated runtime are unchanged from accepted LL12. Native R6/R6a is reused by exact hashes while every native signature/behavior oracle and generated module is recompiled. The new installer remains an isolated proposal pending review and acceptance. No timing claim is made.
